2026-11-02.name: Old Man's / Batu Bolong

daily.headline: More size pushes through. Look to the exposures and magnets for a wave. Trades still expected.
daily.observation: A touch more energy sees a bump in size for the exposures and magnets around the region. Still, don't expect too much action, with surf likely topping out in the chest/shoulder+ high region for these breaks while smaller elsewhere. Trade winds are still likely trending, but some of the Bukit reefs will struggle with the lack of power. Look to the beachies on the higher tide. Better than the last few days, it is worth a paddle.

daily.headline: More shoulder/head high+ surf for the magnets. Fun on the right board. ESE winds
daily.observation: Bigger than the day before, with the exposed breaks and magnets again the only decent options, with some shoulder/head high surf. Again, more ESE winds are on the cards and looking to be a bit stiffer. Bukit cleanest option. Still, keep overall expectations on the lower end of the scale as the overall energy is expected to be on the lower side until later in the day.

2026-11-03.name: Old Man's / Batu Bolong

daily.headline: More shoulder/head high+ surf for the magnets. ESE winds
daily.observation: Rain/storm activity greets us this morning. Surf is a touch bigger than the day before, with the exposed breaks and magnets looking like the only decent options, with some shoulder/head high surf. Again, more ESE winds are on the cards and looking to be a bit stiffer. The bukit will be cleanest option. Still, keep overall expectations on the lower end of the scale as there is plenty of brown water about and overall energy is expected to be down until later in the day.

daily.headline: Fun SSW swell around the region. Beachies likely the pick. Better than the last few days
daily.observation: Chest to overhead high surf at best for the exposed southern breaks and swell magnets around the island. Knee to stomach at less exposed regions. E winds early to favour the west coast before ESE/SEs kick in before lunch. Some reef breaks may struggle a touch but the beachies and sand bottomed breaks will likely be fun enough on a modest low tide.

daily.headline: More waist-to-head-high surf. Not a lot to get excited about but fun enough for the keen.
daily.observation: Much the same as yesterday but touch smaller. Waist to head high surf from the SSW depending on location and exposure to the swell in the water. Dawn/early session should see a fun wave for the west coast beachies under light NE winds before heading to another modest 1.1m low just before lunch. SSE winds to trend from mid morning. Wet season swell, with dry season winds still trending.

2026-11-09.name: Old Man's / Batu Bolong

daily.headline: SSW swell on the fade. Best surf early as size still decent. Light S/SW winds through the AM.
daily.observation: Best size and conditions expected early as we will likely still see some Overhead+ surf for the southern exposures and magnets as the tide pushes in. The SSW swell is on the fade as we expect some energy to drop out limiting options and quality into the afternoon session as SSE winds pick up and set in. Still a fun wave should be found through the first part of the day.

daily.headline: Fading energy continues. Chest to head high. Light winds early. Stronger SSE later.
daily.observation: Less energy, less size and likely a few less options available. Winds are again looking light from the S through the early session, so make the most of the fun head high+ surf heading into the mid morning high tide. Afternoon session likely a little underwhelming with exposures possibly topping out in the shoulder high region under moderate SSE wind flow.

daily.headline: SSW swell smaller again. Options and quality likely limited. Early winds favour the west coast.
daily.observation: Smaller swell and even less size today as we are expecting size to top out in the waist to chest/shoulder high region and really lack some push. The top reef breaks of the Bukit will struggle for quality, so look to the beachies and sand-bottomed breaks. Early NE winds will favour the west coast before SSE kick in for the Bukit through the afternoon. There is set to be some more size tomorrow, with early signs possible late in the day today.
